task.title: Migrate planning loop source root
task.summary: Move planning compiler/gate/tool/type ownership toward src/planning while preserving compatibility until source-contract validation passes.

goal.outcome: Planning loop source ownership is visible under src/planning with compiler/gate/tool/type surfaces for decision-to-roadmap decomposition.
acceptance: src/planning/** contains planning compiler/gate/tool/type entrypoints or direct owner modules for planning-loop behavior.
Existing public/API/tool behavior remains compatible after migration.
Imports from src/roadmap/build/gateway that still support planning are either migrated or documented as compatibility with owner/trigger evidence.
Tests cover planning build creation, planning gate coverage/materialization, and source-contract expectations for the planning root.
No decision-loop or implementation-loop ownership is moved into src/planning.
non_goals: Do not implement implementation root migration.
Do not remove compatibility roots until dependent tests/imports are migrated.
Do not add CodeWiki-repo-specific dogfood behavior.
verification: targeted TASK-117 planning root migration test

delta.desired: src/planning owns planning-loop compiler/gate/tool/type surfaces with compatibility only where explicitly justified.
delta.current: Planning behavior is spread across src/roadmap, src/build, and src/gateway compatibility surfaces; src/planning is missing or not owner-complete.
delta.closure: Closed when planning root exists with tests and source-contract evidence.
